texts.zh:
我们夺得了[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系的控制权，自然也就夺得了环绕在恒星周边，正在建设中的“以太相引擎”。

失去了这座巨型结构，[sphere_builders.GetName]那离经叛道的、企图毁灭整个星系进而入主虚境的妄图彻底破灭了。
texts.en:
We have taken control of the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system, and with it, the "Aetherophasic Engine" that was being built around the star.

The loss of this megastructure puts an end to the deranged scheme of the [sphere_builders.GetName] to invade the Shroud and destroy the galaxy.

label.en: We can make use of this.

tooltips.zh: 我们夺得的以太相引擎将代替我们丢失的那一座。
tooltips.en: The Aetherophasic Engine we have captured shall replace the one we lost.

texts.zh:
由于[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系的失陷，恶毒的[sphere_destroyers.GetName]摧毁了以太相引擎！失去这个巨型结构也意味着我们不再拥有建造新焚天神兵的技术手段。

我们无法继续推进入侵虚境的计划了！全完了！
texts.en:
With the loss of the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system, the vile [sphere_destroyers.GetName] has destroyed our Aetherophasic Engine! Losing this megastructure also means that we no longer have the technological means to build new Star-Eaters.

Our invasion of the Shroud cannot proceed! All is lost!

tooltips.zh: 如果我们能够重新夺回这个恒星系，我们就能惨淡经营，重建以太相引擎
tooltips.en: If we manage to retake the system, we will be able to painstakingly rebuild the Aetherophasic Engine

texts.zh:
在夺取[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系的控制权之后，[sphere_destroyers.GetName]摧毁了正在于此地建造的以太相引擎。

[sphere_builders.GetName]无法再对星系的未来产生威胁了。
texts.en:
After seizing control of the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system, the [sphere_destroyers.GetName] has destroyed the Aetherophasic Engine that was under construction there.

The [sphere_builders.GetName] can no longer threaten the future of our galaxy.
